    scrolling: true

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(shiny)
  library(bslib)
})
source("R/data.R")
source("R/viz.R")

CHOIX_PRENOMS <- q("select prenom, libelle, total from catalogue order by total desc")
CHOIX_PRENOMS <- setNames(CHOIX_PRENOMS$prenom,
                          sprintf("%s (%s)", CHOIX_PRENOMS$libelle, fnum(CHOIX_PRENOMS$total)))
CHOIX_DPT <- q("select dpt, libelle_dpt from departements order by dpt")
CHOIX_DPT <- setNames(CHOIX_DPT$dpt, CHOIX_DPT$libelle_dpt)
DECENNIES <- seq(ANNEE_MIN %/% 10 * 10, ANNEE_MAX %/% 10 * 10, by = 10)
CHOIX_SEXE <- c("Filles" = "F", "Garçons" = "M")

# Clause SQL « sexe » : 'T' = tous
filtre_sexe <- function(s) if (identical(s, "T")) "1 = 1" else sprintf("sexe = '%s'", if (s == "F") "F" else "M")

KPI <- q("
  select
    (select sum(naissances) from naissances) as naissances,
    (select count(*) from catalogue) as prenoms,
    (select annee from naissances group by annee order by sum(naissances) desc limit 1) as annee_record,
    (select max(s) from (select sum(naissances) s from naissances group by annee)) as naissances_record,
    (select libelle from catalogue order by total_f desc limit 1) as top_f,
    (select max(total_f) from catalogue) as top_f_n,
    (select libelle from catalogue order by total_m desc limit 1) as top_m,
    (select max(total_m) from catalogue) as top_m_n")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Les 20 prénoms mixtes les plus portés (10 à 90 % de filles)"
local({
  m <- q("select libelle, total, part_f from catalogue
          where genre = 'Mixte' and total >= 2000 order by total desc limit 20")
  m$libelle <- factor(m$libelle, levels = rev(m$libelle))
  plot_ly(m, y = ~libelle, x = ~part_f, type = "bar", orientation = "h", name = "Filles",
          marker = list(color = COUL_SEXE[["Filles"]]),
          hovertemplate = "%{y} : %{x:.0%} de filles<extra></extra>") |>
    add_bars(x = ~(1 - part_f), name = "Garçons", marker = list(color = COUL_SEXE[["Garçons"]]),
             hovertemplate = "%{y} : %{x:.0%} de garçons<extra></extra>") |>
    style_plotly() |>
    layout(barmode = "stack", hovermode = "closest", bargap = 0.25,
           xaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1)), yaxis = list(title = "", gridcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"))
})
```

# À propos

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Sources & méthode"
htmltools::div(class = "apropos",
  htmltools::HTML(sprintf('
<p><b>Données</b> : INSEE, <i>Fichier des prénoms</i> (état civil), diffusé sur
<a href="https://www.data.gouv.fr/fr/datasets/fichier-des-prenoms-depuis-1900/" target="_blank">data.gouv.fr</a>.
Édition chargée : <code>%s</code> — années %d à %d. Fichier départemental : niveau le plus fin (sexe × prénom × année × département).</p>
<p><b>Secret statistique</b> : au niveau national, les prénoms donnés moins de 3 fois une année sont regroupés en « prénoms rares ».
Au niveau départemental, un prénom n\'apparaît que s\'il a été donné au moins 3 fois sur l\'année et 20 fois sur la période ;
sinon l\'année et/ou le département sont masqués. Les totaux de naissances incluent les prénoms rares, les classements les excluent.</p>
<p><b>Sans fichier national</b>, les séries nationales sont agrégées depuis le fichier départemental : les naissances dont l\'année est masquée
n\'y figurent pas (totaux annuels légèrement sous-estimés). <code>Rscript R/ingest.R --dpt-file … --nat-file …</code> corrige cela.</p>
<p><b>Chaîne de traitement</b> : <code>R/ingest.R</code> (DuckDB) → Parquet (<code>data/</code>) → DuckDB en mémoire (<code>R/data.R</code>)
→ Quarto Dashboard + Shiny (<code>prenoms.qmd</code>), graphiques plotly, tableaux DT.</p>
<p><b>Fond de carte</b> : <a href="https://github.com/VictorCazanave/svg-maps" target="_blank">svg-maps</a> (CC-BY-4.0), converti par <code>R/contours.R</code>.</p>
<p>Jumeau R du tableau de bord Evidence <code>prenoms-dashboard/</code>.</p>',
  META$edition %||% META$source, ANNEE_MIN, ANNEE_MAX)))
```

```{r}
#| context: server

# ======================================================================= Vue d'ensemble
top_annee <- reactive({
  q("with r as (
       select sexe, prenom, libelle, annee, nombre, rang, pour_mille,
              lag(rang) over (partition by sexe, prenom order by annee) as rang_prec
       from rangs where annee in (? - 1, ?)
     )
     select sexe, rang, libelle, nombre, pour_mille / 1000 as part, rang_prec - rang as gain
     from r where annee = ? and rang <= 15 order by sexe, rang",
    input$annee_top, input$annee_top, input$annee_top)
})

table_top <- function(d) {
  d$gain <- ifelse(is.na(d$gain), "nouveau", ifelse(d$gain > 0, paste0("+", d$gain), ifelse(d$gain == 0, "=", d$gain)))
  tableau(setNames(d[, c("rang", "libelle", "nombre", "part", "gain")],
                   c("#", "Prénom", "Naissances", "Part", "Δ rang")), pageLength = 15) |>
    formatRound(3, digits = 0, mark = " ") |>
    formatPercentage(4, digits = 2, dec.mark = ",") |>
    formatStyle("Δ rang", color = styleEqual(c("="), c("#8a8984"), default = NULL)) |>
    formatStyle("Naissances", background = styleColorBar(c(0, max(d$nombre)), "#cfe0f6"),
                backgroundSize = "98% 70%", backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat", backgroundPosition = "center")
}
output$top_f <- renderDT(table_top(subset(top_annee(), sexe == "F")))
output$top_m <- renderDT(table_top(subset(top_annee(), sexe == "M")))

# ======================================================================= Explorer un prénom
updateSelectizeInput(session, "prenom", choices = CHOIX_PRENOMS, selected = "MARIE", server = TRUE)
updateSelectizeInput(session, "comparer", choices = CHOIX_PRENOMS,
                     selected = c("LÉA", "EMMA", "JADE", "LOUISE"), server = TRUE)

prenom_sel <- reactive({ req(input$prenom); input$prenom })
fiche <- reactive(q("select * from catalogue where prenom = ?", prenom_sel()))

evolution <- reactive({
  q(sprintf("select annee, sexe, nombre, pour_mille / 1000 as part, rang
             from rangs where prenom = ? and %s order by annee", filtre_sexe(input$sexe_p)), prenom_sel())
})

output$vb_total <- renderText(fnum(fiche()$total))
output$vb_pic <- renderText(fiche()$annee_pic)
output$vb_pic_n <- renderText(paste(fnum(fiche()$naissances_pic), "naissances cette année-là"))
meilleur <- reactive(q(sprintf("select min(rang) as rang, arg_min(annee, rang * 10000 + annee) as annee from rangs
                                where prenom = ? and %s", filtre_sexe(input$sexe_p)), prenom_sel()))
output$vb_rang <- renderText(if (is.na(meilleur()$rang)) "—" else paste0("n°", meilleur()$rang))
output$vb_rang_annee <- renderText(if (is.na(meilleur()$annee)) "" else paste("atteint en", meilleur()$annee))
output$vb_part_f <- renderText(fpct(fiche()$part_f, 0))
output$vb_genre <- renderText(paste("Prénom", tolower(fiche()$genre)))

output$evol_n <- renderPlotly(serie_sexe(evolution(), "nombre", type = "bar"))
output$evol_part <- renderPlotly(serie_sexe(evolution(), "part", fmt_y = ".2%"))
output$evol_rang <- renderPlotly(
  serie_sexe(evolution(), "rang") |>
    layout(yaxis = list(type = "log", autorange = "reversed", title = "rang (échelle log, 1 = le plus donné)"))
)

geo <- reactive({
  debut <- as.integer(input$periode)
  fin <- if (debut == 0) 9999L else debut + 9L
  fs <- filtre_sexe(input$sexe_p)
  q(sprintf("
    with p as (
      select dpt, sum(nombre) as n from detail
      where prenom = ? and %s and annee between ? and ? group by dpt
    ),
    t as (
      select dpt, sum(naissances) as total from naissances_dpt
      where %s and annee between ? and ?
        and annee in (select distinct annee from detail where prenom = ?)
      group by dpt
    )
    select d.dpt, d.nom, coalesce(p.n, 0) as naissances,
           1000.0 * coalesce(p.n, 0) / t.total as pour_mille,
           (1000.0 * coalesce(p.n, 0) / t.total) /
             (1000.0 * sum(coalesce(p.n, 0)) over () / sum(t.total) over ()) as indice
    from departements d join t using (dpt) left join p using (dpt)
    order by pour_mille desc", fs, fs), prenom_sel(), debut, fin, debut, fin, prenom_sel())
})

output$carte_prenom <- renderPlotly({
  carte_france(geo(), valeur = "pour_mille", titre_legende = "‰ des naissances", fmt = fpm,
               info = function(r) sprintf("%s naissances · indice %s", fnum(r$naissances), fnum(r$indice, 2)))
})
output$geo_prenom <- renderDT({
  g <- geo()[, c("nom", "naissances", "pour_mille", "indice")]
  tableau(setNames(g, c("Département", "Naissances", "‰", "Indice")), pageLength = 12, recherche = TRUE) |>
    formatRound(2, digits = 0, mark = " ") |>
    formatRound(c(3, 4), digits = 2, dec.mark = ",") |>
    formatStyle("‰", background = styleColorBar(c(0, max(g$pour_mille, na.rm = TRUE)), "#b5d2f4"),
                backgroundSize = "98% 70%", backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat", backgroundPosition = "center")
})

output$comparaison <- renderPlotly({
  req(length(input$comparer) > 0)
  noms <- paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, input$comparer), collapse = ", ")
  d <- q(sprintf("select annee, libelle, sum(nombre) as naissances from france
                  where prenom in (%s) and not est_rare group by all order by annee", noms))
  ordre <- unique(q(sprintf("select libelle from catalogue where prenom in (%s) order by total desc", noms))$libelle)
  d$libelle <- factor(d$libelle, levels = ordre)
  plot_ly(d, x = ~annee, y = ~naissances, color = ~libelle, colors = PAL[seq_along(ordre)]) |>
    add_lines(line = list(width = 2)) |>
    style_plotly() |> layout(yaxis = list(tickformat = ",d"))
})

# ======================================================================= Explorer un département
dpt_sel <- reactive({ req(input$dpt); input$dpt })
dec <- reactive(as.integer(input$decennie))

info_dpt <- reactive({
  q("select d.*,
       (select sum(naissances) from naissances_dpt where dpt = ?) as naissances,
       (select count(distinct prenom) from detail where dpt = ?) as prenoms,
       (select libelle from detail where dpt = ? and sexe = 'F' group by libelle order by sum(nombre) desc limit 1) as top_f,
       (select libelle from detail where dpt = ? and sexe = 'M' group by libelle order by sum(nombre) desc limit 1) as top_m
     from departements d where d.dpt = ?", dpt_sel(), dpt_sel(), dpt_sel(), dpt_sel(), dpt_sel())
})
output$vb_d_naiss <- renderText(fnum(info_dpt()$naissances))
output$vb_d_nom <- renderText(sprintf("%s · %s", info_dpt()$nom, info_dpt()$region))
output$vb_d_prenoms <- renderText(fnum(info_dpt()$prenoms))
output$vb_d_f <- renderText(info_dpt()$top_f)
output$vb_d_m <- renderText(info_dpt()$top_m)

output$carte_situation <- renderPlotly(carte_france(DEPTS, mode = "situation", surbrillance = dpt_sel()))

output$d_naissances <- renderPlotly({
  serie_sexe(q("select annee, sexe, naissances from naissances_dpt where dpt = ? order by annee", dpt_sel()),
             "naissances", type = "area")
})

output$d_palmares <- renderDT({
  d <- q("with x as (
            select libelle, sum(nombre) as n from detail
            where dpt = ? and sexe = ? and annee between ? and ? + 9 group by all
          )
          select row_number() over (order by n desc) as rang, libelle, n, n / sum(n) over () as part
          from x qualify rang <= 20 order by rang", dpt_sel(), input$sexe_d, dec(), dec())
  tableau(setNames(d, c("#", "Prénom", "Naissances", "Part (prénoms publiés)")), pageLength = 20) |>
    formatRound(3, digits = 0, mark = " ") |>
    formatPercentage(4, digits = 1, dec.mark = ",") |>
    formatStyle("Naissances", background = styleColorBar(c(0, max(d$n)), "#cfe0f6"),
                backgroundSize = "98% 70%", backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat", backgroundPosition = "center")
})

output$d_specifiques <- renderPlotly({
  d <- q("with loc as (
            select prenom, libelle, sum(nombre) as n from detail
            where dpt = ? and sexe = ? and annee between ? and ? + 9 group by all
          ),
          loc_tot as (select sum(naissances) as t from naissances_dpt
                      where dpt = ? and sexe = ? and annee between ? and ? + 9),
          nat as (select prenom, sum(nombre) as n from france
                  where sexe = ? and annee between ? and ? + 9 group by all),
          nat_tot as (select sum(naissances) as t from naissances
                      where sexe = ? and annee between ? and ? + 9)
          select loc.libelle, loc.n, (loc.n / loc_tot.t) / (nat.n / nat_tot.t) as indice
          from loc join nat using (prenom), loc_tot, nat_tot
          where loc.n >= 30 order by indice desc limit 15",
         dpt_sel(), input$sexe_d, dec(), dec(), dpt_sel(), input$sexe_d, dec(), dec(),
         input$sexe_d, dec(), dec(), input$sexe_d, dec(), dec())
  validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "Pas assez de données pour cette décennie."))
  barres_h(d, "indice", "libelle", couleur = PAL[3], fmt_x = ".1f")
})

output$d_numero_un <- renderDT({
  d <- q("with r as (
            select annee // 10 * 10 as decennie, sexe, libelle, sum(nombre) as n
            from detail where dpt = ? group by 1, 2, 3
            qualify row_number() over (partition by decennie, sexe order by n desc) = 1
          )
          select decennie::varchar || 's' as Décennie,
                 max(libelle) filter (where sexe = 'F') as \"Fille n°1\", max(n) filter (where sexe = 'F') as \"Naissances \",
                 max(libelle) filter (where sexe = 'M') as \"Garçon n°1\", max(n) filter (where sexe = 'M') as Naissances
          from r group by decennie order by decennie desc", dpt_sel())
  tableau(d, pageLength = 13) |> formatRound(c(3, 5), digits = 0, mark = " ")
})

# ======================================================================= La France des prénoms
top_dpt <- reactive({
  q("with r as (
       select dpt, libelle, nombre,
              row_number() over (partition by dpt order by nombre desc, libelle) as rk
       from detail where annee = ? and sexe = ?
     )
     select r.dpt, d.nom, r.libelle as prenom, r.nombre as naissances,
            r.nombre::double / t.naissances as part
     from r join departements d using (dpt)
     join naissances_dpt t on t.dpt = r.dpt and t.annee = ? and t.sexe = ?
     where rk = 1 order by r.dpt", input$annee_c, input$sexe_c, input$annee_c, input$sexe_c)
})

output$carte_top <- renderPlotly({
  carte_france(top_dpt(), valeur = "naissances", categorie = "prenom", titre_legende = "naissances :",
               info = function(r) paste(fpct(r$part), "des naissances du département"))
})
output$top_resume <- renderDT({
  d <- aggregate(cbind(departements = 1, naissances = naissances) ~ prenom, data = top_dpt(), FUN = sum)
  d <- d[order(-d$departements, -d$naissances), ]
  tableau(setNames(d, c("Prénom", "Départements", "Naissances")), pageLength = 12) |>
    formatRound(3, digits = 0, mark = " ") |>
    formatStyle("Départements", background = styleColorBar(c(0, max(d$departements)), "#cfe0f6"),
                backgroundSize = "98% 70%", backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat", backgroundPosition = "center")
})
output$top_detail <- renderDT({
  d <- top_dpt()[, c("dpt", "nom", "prenom", "naissances", "part")]
  tableau(setNames(d, c("Code", "Département", "Prénom n°1", "Naissances", "Part")), pageLength = 12, recherche = TRUE) |>
    formatRound(4, digits = 0, mark = " ") |> formatPercentage(5, digits = 1, dec.mark = ",")
})

indicateurs <- reactive({
  q("with det as (
       select dpt, count(distinct prenom) as prenoms_distincts, sum(nombre) as publies
       from detail where annee = ? and sexe = ? group by dpt
     )
     select d.dpt, d.nom, t.naissances, 1 - det.publies::double / t.naissances as part_rares
     from departements d
     join naissances_dpt t on t.dpt = d.dpt and t.annee = ? and t.sexe = ?
     left join det on det.dpt = d.dpt", input$annee_c, input$sexe_c, input$annee_c, input$sexe_c)
})
output$carte_naiss <- renderPlotly(carte_france(indicateurs(), valeur = "naissances", titre_legende = "naissances"))
output$carte_rares <- renderPlotly(carte_france(indicateurs(), valeur = "part_rares", titre_legende = "part", fmt = fpct))

# ======================================================================= Tendances
evolutions <- reactive({
  a <- input$periode_t[1]; b <- input$periode_t[2]
  q("with a as (select prenom, libelle, nombre, pour_mille, rang from rangs where annee = ? and sexe = ?),
          b as (select prenom, libelle, nombre, pour_mille, rang from rangs where annee = ? and sexe = ?)
     select coalesce(b.libelle, a.libelle) as libelle,
            coalesce(b.pour_mille, 0) - coalesce(a.pour_mille, 0) as ecart
     from a full join b using (prenom)", a, input$sexe_t, b, input$sexe_t)
})
output$hausses <- renderPlotly({
  d <- head(evolutions()[order(-evolutions()$ecart), ], 12)
  barres_h(d, "ecart", "libelle", couleur = PAL[3], fmt_x = "+.1f")
})
output$baisses <- renderPlotly({
  d <- head(evolutions()[order(evolutions()$ecart), ], 12)
  barres_h(d, "ecart", "libelle", couleur = PAL[8], fmt_x = "+.1f") |> layout(xaxis = list(autorange = "reversed"))
})

output$course <- renderPlotly({
  fin <- input$periode_t[2]
  d <- q("with top as (select prenom, rang from rangs where annee = ? and sexe = ? and rang <= 15)
          select r.annee, r.libelle, r.pour_mille, top.rang as rang_fin
          from rangs r join top using (prenom)
          where r.sexe = ? and r.annee between ? - 30 and ?
          order by top.rang", fin, input$sexe_t, input$sexe_t, fin, fin)
  ordre <- unique(d$libelle[order(d$rang_fin)])
  plot_ly(d, x = ~annee, y = ~factor(libelle, levels = rev(ordre)), z = ~pour_mille, type = "heatmap",
          colorscale = list(c(0, RAMPE[1]), c(0.5, RAMPE[5]), c(1, RAMPE[7])),
          xgap = 2, ygap = 2, colorbar = list(title = "‰", thickness = 10),
          hovertemplate = "%{y} en %{x} : %{z:.2f} ‰<extra></extra>") |>
    style_plotly(legende = FALSE) |>
    layout(hovermode = "closest", yaxis = list(title = "", gridcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"),
           xaxis = list(dtick = 5))
})
```
